name: @activepieces/piece-vercel
description: Deploy projects and manage environment variables on Vercel.

auth.description: Authenticate with a Vercel personal access token. Optionally provide a team ID or team slug to operate on team-owned resources.

token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.

teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.

slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.

list_projects.name: list_projects
list_projects.description: Retrieve all Vercel projects for the authenticated user or team.

aiMetadata.description: List Vercel projects for the authenticated account or team, paging through all results. Leave the search value empty to fetch every project, or set it to filter projects by name. Use this to discover project IDs/names before deploying or managing env vars. Read-only and idempotent.

create_deployment.name: create_deployment
create_deployment.description: Create a deployment for an existing Vercel project using either a redeploy source deployment ID or a git source payload.

auth.description: Authenticate with a Vercel personal access token. Optionally provide a team ID or team slug to operate on team-owned resources.

token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.

teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.

slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.

deployment_source.description: Choose whether to redeploy a previous deployment or deploy from a connected Git source.

auth.description: Authenticate with a Vercel personal access token. Optionally provide a team ID or team slug to operate on team-owned resources.

token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.

teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.

slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.

force_new.description: Create a new deployment even if a previous similar deployment exists.

skip_auto_detection_confirmation.description: Automatically confirm framework detection without prompting.

aiMetadata.description: Trigger a new deployment for an existing Vercel project. Operates in one of two modes: redeploy an existing deployment by its ID (optionally using the latest commit), or deploy from a connected Git source (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket) by branch/ref plus repo identifiers. Requires a target project; for Git mode a branch/ref and either a repo ID or org+repo name are mandatory. Not idempotent: each call starts a separate deployment.

get_deployment_status.name: get_deployment_status
get_deployment_status.description: Retrieve a deployment and inspect its current status.

teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.

slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.

auth.description: Authenticate with a Vercel personal access token. Optionally provide a team ID or team slug to operate on team-owned resources.

token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.

teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.

slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single Vercel deployment by ID and inspect its current state (e.g. building, ready, error), optionally including Git repository info. Use this to poll or check the outcome of a deployment. Requires the deployment ID, scoped to a chosen project. Read-only and idempotent.

list_environment_variables.name: list_environment_variables
list_environment_variables.description: Retrieve environment variables for a Vercel project.

auth.description: Authenticate with a Vercel personal access token. Optionally provide a team ID or team slug to operate on team-owned resources.

token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.

teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.

slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.

decrypt.description: Deprecated by Vercel. If enabled, Vercel will attempt to return decrypted values when allowed.

git_branch.description: Optional branch filter. Only valid for preview-scoped variables.

aiMetadata.description: List the environment variables configured on a Vercel project, optionally filtered to a specific Git branch (preview-scoped vars only) and optionally requesting decrypted values where permitted. Use this to discover existing keys before reading or upserting a variable. Requires the target project. Read-only and idempotent.

upsert_environment_variable.name: upsert_environment_variable
upsert_environment_variable.description: Create or update a Vercel environment variable using Vercel's upsert API.

auth.description: Authenticate with a Vercel personal access token. Optionally provide a team ID or team slug to operate on team-owned resources.

token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.

teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.

slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.

target.description: Environment(s) where this variable should apply.

git_branch.description: Optional branch. Only valid when Preview is one of the selected targets.

comment.description: Optional note describing the variable usage.

aiMetadata.description: Create or update an environment variable on a Vercel project via Vercel's upsert endpoint, keyed by the variable name. Choose the variable type (plain, sensitive, or encrypted) and one or more target environments (production, preview, development); a Git branch may only be set when preview is among the targets. Use when you need a specific key set to a known value. Idempotent: repeating with the same key and value yields the same stored variable.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to Vercel. The Authorization header is injected automatically. If your connection uses Team ID or Team Slug, add `teamId` or `slug` manually in the URL or Query Parameters for team-scoped requests.

auth.description: Authenticate with a Vercel personal access token. Optionally provide a team ID or team slug to operate on team-owned resources.

token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.

slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.
